cls: DCHECK is not built into production Chrome binaries. The `format->` dereference could be a source for a Chrome crash. We should `LOGF(ERROR)` and return `false` if `format` does not have a value.
Can you rework this else branch to limit your change to when `#if BUILDFLAG(IS_LINUX) && BUILDFLAG(USE_V4L2_CODEC)` evaluates to true? I am worried about side effects of dropping the CHECK for…
